profile.headline: Game Developer | Software Engineer | PhD Astrophysicist
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with over ten years of teaching and collaborative work experience in academia. I earned my Ph.D. in astrophysics in 2022, and I have worked in the software industry ever since. See my projects to learn more about games, apps, and other software I’ve released.

honors.title: University Graduate Fellowship
honors.description: The Graduate School sponsors one hundred University Graduate Fellowships. This prestigious fellowship program is available to incoming students and provides payment of tuition and a base stipend, as well as a health insurance subsidy. Some colleges increase the stipend with their own funding.

honors.title: Chancellor Recognition Award (Cumulative 4.0 GPA)
honors.description: This award is saved for graduating students who have received a perfect 4.0 GPA over the span of their undergraduate career.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Colorado Boulder - College of Arts and Sciences · May 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: The Research Committee provides opportunities to undergraduate students interested in pursuing astronomical research. The committee teaches methods for data acquisition, analysis, and instrumentation, and provides opportunities for committee members to work on guided research projects in astronomy.

The Outreach Committee provides opportunities to undergraduate students interested in public science outreach. The committee members create curricula and materials for outreach events at local schools, and then attend those events to teach the students about topics in astronomy.

projects.title: Operator: Math Puzzle Game
projects.description: Developed an original math puzzle game for iOS (SwiftUI) and Android (Jetpack Compose) using the Clean architectural design pattern. The game features four difficulty levels, a daily puzzle mode, online leaderboards, dozens of achievements, and more! (Swift, Kotlin)

projects.title: PyPI Maker
projects.description: Designed a program to simplify uploading Python packages to the Python Package Index (PyPI). The program runs entirely within a window-based graphical user interface, so as to not require from the user any knowledge of the otherwise rather lengthy and tedious process involved in uploading and managing a package on PyPI.
